title: Generalization phenomena less pronounced on natural data
description: The paper acknowledges that the striking generalization patterns (decoupling of train and validation performance, late generalization) are significantly less pronounced on natural datasets than on the studied algorithmic datasets.
canonical_description: the studied generalization phenomena are significantly less pronounced on natural datasets than on small algorithmic datasets

evidence.quote: training networks on small algorithmically generated datasets can reliably exhibit unusual generalization patterns, clearly decoupled from performance on the training set, in a significantly more pronounced way than such effects manifest on datasets derived from natural data.
